analysis.summary: This analysis outlines two functional requirements related to a task-list prototype for users to add and manage tasks, integrating basic functionality and technology selection considerations.

functionalRequirements.description: A user can add a task with a title.
A user can mark a task as complete.

assumptions.description: The user requires a simple interface to interact with their task list.
assumptions.validationNeeded: User experience feedback on the proposed interface.

assumptions.description: Tasks do not require additional attributes such as due dates or priority levels.
assumptions.validationNeeded: Confirmation on whether users need more task attributes.

risks.description: There may be inadequate user engagement if the task list lacks features users expect.
risks.suggestedMitigation: Consider conducting user interviews to understand essential features.

risks.description: Without a clear technology stack, it is challenging to define system architecture.
risks.suggestedMitigation: Draft a list of potential stacks and evaluate them against project needs.

openQuestions.question: What specific technologies should be considered for the implementation of the task-list prototype?
What additional features, if any, do users desire for better task management?

architecture.summary: This proposal outlines a small task-list prototype where a user can add tasks with a title and mark them complete. It consists of two main components and a technology decision proposal to support the functional requirements identified during analysis.

components.name: TaskManager
components.responsibility: Handles task addition and completion functionality for the task list.

components.name: UserInterface
components.responsibility: Provides a simple interface for user interactions with the task list.

technologyDecisions.rationale: Using a client-side framework like React allows for a responsive and interactive user interface, crucial for task management functionalities.

alternatives.benefits: Lightweight and no external dependencies required for small-scale projects.
alternatives.drawbacks: Increased complexity in managing state and UI updates as the application grows.

alternatives.benefits: Simplifies DOM manipulation and event handling.
alternatives.drawbacks: Not as efficient for larger applications and lacks modern reactive features.

tradeOffs: React provides a modern, component-based architecture and better user experience but adds complexity in setup.
Vanilla JavaScript keeps the project simple but can become unwieldy for more advanced interfacing as it grows.
